# A platform argument check introduces a site identifier in the receiver.
# An unrewritable fork-only call must be refused before output is accepted.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos build .
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'fork_stdlib_api.*EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect'
! exists out/main.go

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/h2sitereceiver

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"net/http"
)

func serverFor(f *flag.Flag) *http.Server {
	_ = f
	return &http.Server{}
}

func main() {
	flag.String("listen", ":0", "listen address")
	serverFor(flag.Lookup("listen")).EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()
}
